title: Buying all the furniture with cash
summary: At a Cottage Grove store Louella picked out and half paid for everything, to the shopkeeper's surprise.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: "And now we're goin' downtown and pick out some furniture."
I said, "I don't know about pickin' out no furniture. You do the pickin' out of. I'll just nod my haid."
She said, "Okay, I'll get what I think you like. If you jus' don't like it, you tell me so."
So I say to her, "Whatever you buy's all right with me."
"We-e-e-yea, okay. Here we go. Well, git up and get outa the bed an' put your clothes on."
I said, "Well, I gotta take a shower."

"You just wash up. Ain't got time for you to fool around. You go in the bathroom an' take two...three hours foolin' around." Say, "You just go in there and wash up, put on your clothes. We goin' 'cause I got to go to work early tonight."
"Arright."
Reel 4

So we went to a furniture store over on Cottage Grove. Great big furniture store. She bought beds. She bought dressers. She bought end tables. She bought ever'thing. She bought couches. She done eve' thing. She furnished up the whole house with a brand new stove...ever'- thing...breakfast set...all that stuff. The man say, "Is this a charge?" She say, "Yeah, we charge some of it but most we gonna pay most of it down."

So the little Jew fellow was so happy. When we walked in the store, there was two...three other people in there, and so they just kind of overlooked us. We didn't look too rich. So, the little Jew fellow come over and said, "Can I help you-all?"

So we started buyin' all...orderin' up all this stuff. Eve'- body started lookin'...showin'..."How you like this? How you like this? How you like that?" She picked out all the stuff. She picked it all out. Said, "You want all that stuff you picked out?" She say, "You written it down, didn't you?" Say, "Yeah." Say, "Jes'...pick it up." Say, "This is on credit?" He didn't have no idea she gonna pay cash.
She say, "No, it's cash." He liked to fell off his stool. So I tol' her, I say, "We ain't payin' cash for that stuff. We buyin' it on credit like ever'body else do."
Reel 4
"Well, I want to pay half down on it so I know darn well they ain't never gonna come back and git it."
say, "Well, you runnin' the show." Me, I wanna give the man somethin' down an' a dollar when I catch me.
she made the deal. Say, "When can you deliver?"
"Mrs. Turner, we deliver it for you three days." Say, "Because all this stuff is on the floor. We have to go to the warehouse an' pick it up."
said, "Make it a day-and-a-half, an' you gotta deal."
"A day-and-a-half it is, Mrs. Turner."
